text:
maya: Postmortem linked (INC-4822). We saw our gradual launches overlap heavy priming and that pushed the blast radius way up. Need small, actionable follow-ups: telemetry per-cohort, a blast_radius cap, blackout enforcement, and an auto-revert prototype.

eric: 2 quick asks: add cohort labels to metrics pipeline (1d) and a lint that forces owner metadata on flags (2d).

dom: I'll take the auto-revert prototype. Proposal: detect sustained anomaly (error delta >=2% or p95 +200ms for 4m) then revert to last-good variant and post alert. Target: 48h to demo.

carla: +1. add tenant-level opt-out for Dedicated customers. default: auto-revert on for self-serve, off for Dedicated.

oncall-sre: observed pattern: two incidents had launches within the 01:00-03:30 UTC priming window. Recommend a blackout policy that blocks staged launches during heavy job windows by default.

maya: agree. owner for blackout enforcement?

eric: i'll own blackout enforcement in CI and release pipeline. will add a job that checks `infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml` and fails CI if overlap. ETA: Tue EOD.

dom: for the prototype I'll include a short-circuit: if cohort_kv_miss_rate > 0.1 then immediate pause. That avoids rolling back for unrelated errors.

carla: also need a 3-shard default blast_radius cap for new flags, 5 for legacy. enforce via server-side validation.

eric: YAML sketch for policy I pushed to a branch:
```yaml
launch_policy:
  blackout_windows:
    - tz: UTC
      start: "01:00"
      end: "03:30"
  blast_radius_default: 3
  dedicated_auto_revert: false
```

maya: nice. dom, please link your demo PR here when ready. carla, please add dedicated opt-out metadata in the flag schema. eric, add the CI check and a release-note warning.

dom: opening draft INF-1153 for auto-revert. devops-bot plz create job for shadow run.

devops-bot: ticket INF-1153 "auto-revert prototype" created and assigned to dom. CI job `launch-safety-check` scheduled.

oncall-sre: after prototype, run a 7-day shadow on staging with traffic replay that includes priming spikes. owner: oncall-sre, due: 14d.

eric: i'll also add a weekly telemetry report that flags rollouts with cohort_kv_miss > 8% or error spikes, SQL draft below:
```sql
SELECT rollout_id, flag, AVG(kv_miss) as avg_kv_miss, SUM(errors) as total_err
FROM rollout_metrics
WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY rollout_id, flag
HAVING AVG(kv_miss) > 0.08 OR SUM(errors) > 5
ORDER BY avg_kv_miss DESC;
```

carla: support wants a 3-bullet customer-facing template for when auto-revert triggers. I'll draft and post here.

maya: summary of follow-ups (owner, due): (cohort labels + lint: eric, 2d), (auto-revert PR: dom, 2d), (blackout CI check: eric, Tue EOD), (blast_radius schema + defaults: carla, 5d), (shadow staging run: oncall-sre, 14d), (support template: carla, 3d). I'll update the postmortem tracker and set reminders.

dom: ack.

eric: ack.

carla: ack — will include an ownership column in the CSV export for flag inventory.

oncall-sre: adding a recurring monthly review to the incident board to surface rollout timing clusters.

maya: thanks all. ping here if blockers. will escalate any slips to PMs. :white_check_mark:
